# gen_mcp v0.10.0 - Table of Contents

> A generic MCP server behaviour for the latest protocol version with a suite of components to build tools, resources and prompts.

## GUIDES

- [Changelog](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

- Introduction
  - [Getting Started](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/001-getting-started.md)
  - [Using GenMCP Suite](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/002-using-mcp-suite.md)
  - [System Configuration](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/009-system-configuration.md)

## Modules

- Core
  - [GenMCP](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/GenMCP.md): The main behaviour for MCP servers.
  - [GenMCP.MCP](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/GenMCP.MCP.md): Helpers for building MCP payload structs from Servers, Tools or repositories.
  - [GenMCP.Transport.StreamableHTTP](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/GenMCP.Transport.StreamableHTTP.md): Handles incoming MCP requests over HTTP with SSE support.

- Suite
  - [GenMCP.Suite](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/GenMCP.Suite.md): A `GenMCP` implementation providing tools, resources, and prompts through a
composable extension system.
  - [GenMCP.Suite.Extension](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/GenMCP.Suite.Extension.md): A behaviour describing extensions to the `GenMCP.Suite` server.
  - [GenMCP.Suite.PersistedClientInfo](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/GenMCP.Suite.PersistedClientInfo.md): This module represents data that must be persisted in session storage
when using a `GenMCP.Suite.SessionController` implementation that persists and
restore long lived sessions.
  - [GenMCP.Suite.PromptRepo](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/GenMCP.Suite.PromptRepo.md): Defines the behaviour for implementing prompt repositories.
  - [GenMCP.Suite.ResourceRepo](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/GenMCP.Suite.ResourceRepo.md): Defines the behaviour for resource repositories and handles their execution.
  - [GenMCP.Suite.SessionController](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/GenMCP.Suite.SessionController.md): Behaviour for session controllers.

  - [GenMCP.Suite.SessionController.DevSessionStore](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/GenMCP.Suite.SessionController.DevSessionStore.md): An implementation of `GenMCP.Suite.SessionController` that persists the
session to disk.
  - [GenMCP.Suite.Tool](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/GenMCP.Suite.Tool.md): Defines the behaviour for implementing MCP tools in `GenMCP.Suite`.

- Sessions
  - [GenMCP.Mux.Channel](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/GenMCP.Mux.Channel.md)
  - [GenMCP.Mux.Session](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/GenMCP.Mux.Session.md): A GenServer based module used for processes representing an ongoing MCP
session.

- Utilities
  - [GenMCP.Error](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/GenMCP.Error.md): Helper module used to transform application errors into MCP/RPC error
payloads and HTTP status codes.

  - [GenMCP.TelemetryLogger](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/GenMCP.TelemetryLogger.md): A `:telemetry` event listener that produces logs for events emitted by the
`:gen_mcp` application.

- Protocol

  - [GenMCP.MCP.AudioContent](https://gen-mcp.hexdocs.pm/GenMCP.MCP.AudioContent.md)
